parrafo_1.es: Leonel International Tile Corp es un showroom y distribuidor de porcelanato, ceramica y piedra en Hialeah. Clientes destacan a Annie, quien conoce el inventario de memoria y ayuda a elegir la baldosa correcta para cada espacio.
parrafo_1.en: Leonel International Tile Corp is a porcelain, ceramic and stone showroom and distributor in Hialeah. Customers single out Annie, who knows the inventory by heart and helps pick the right tile for every room.

parrafo_2.es: El inventario incluye porcelanato, ceramica, piedra natural y vanities, con muestras fisicas en el showroom para que veas y toques el material antes de decidir.
parrafo_2.en: The inventory covers porcelain, ceramic, natural stone and vanities, with physical samples on the showroom floor so you can see and touch the material before you decide.

texto.es: Pasa por 209 W 21st St en Hialeah y ve el porcelanato, la ceramica y la piedra en persona, no en una foto.
texto.en: Stop by 209 W 21st St in Hialeah and see the porcelain, ceramic and stone in person, not on a screen.

texto.es: El equipo del showroom te ayuda a comparar opciones segun el espacio, el uso y el presupuesto.
texto.en: The showroom team helps you compare options based on the room, the use and the budget.

texto.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza segun el material y la cantidad. Llama a la tienda y te damos el detalle.
texto.en: Every project is quoted based on the material and the quantity. Call the store and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Retira tu material en el local o coordina la entrega para tu proyecto.
texto.en: Pick up your material on site or arrange delivery for your project.

nota.es: Los precios varian segun el material y la cantidad. Llama a la tienda al +1 (305) 883-7160 y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Prices vary by material and quantity. Call the store at +1 (305) 883-7160 and we will give you the details, no strings attached.

texto.es: Para piso y pared, en acabados tipo madera, marmol y liso. El material que mas se mueve en el showroom.
texto.en: For floors and walls, in wood look, marble look and plain finishes. The material that moves the most in the showroom.

texto.es: Opcion solida para cocinas y banos, con variedad de tamanos y colores disponibles en inventario.
texto.en: A solid option for kitchens and bathrooms, with a range of sizes and colors in stock.

texto.es: Marmol y piedra para duchas y acentos de pared, el mismo material que ves en nuestras fotos de proyectos.
texto.en: Marble and stone for showers and wall accents, the same material you see in our project photos.

texto.es: Tocadores y accesorios para completar la remodelacion de bano, disponibles en el showroom.
texto.en: Vanities and fixtures to finish off a bathroom remodel, available on the showroom floor.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas en la foto? Pasa por el showroom, el inventario cambia seguido.
pie.en: Do not see what you need in the photos? Stop by the showroom, the inventory changes often.

items.quote: Had a first class experience with Annie, she knows every tile by memory and has amazing taste for recommendations.

This store has a great selection of tiles and all the accompanying materials. The courteous and helpful attention we received from Annie stood out the most. I will definitely come back for any future tile purchase.
Great service, friendly and super helpful! Annie was very polite and detailed in helping us choose tiles and guided us in choosing the correct tile for our bathroom. Highly recommend!
